completion_handoff.scope: actual local Vue/Pinia/shared-query/upload-runtime path; fixed 150ms simulated response delay per HTTP call; no production network, DOM paint, SQL timing or latency guarantee

production_database.scope: read-only low-frequency MySQL samples, same configured DB/account excluding this diagnostic connection; not direct application-pool counters or a production load test
limitations: Low-traffic observation for about one minute, not production capacity or P95.
Connection metadata groups the configured database/account; it is not direct in-process pool occupancy or pending queue telemetry.
Five-second sampling can miss transient active queries; the diagnostic connection is excluded from matching counts but contributes to global status.
Lock counters are MySQL-global; per-database performance_schema lock details were not permitted.
No authenticated authorization-callback or draft keepalive latency was measured.
No production stress, configuration/policy changes, business writes or queue-limit changes were performed.

previous_isolated_saturation_evidence.scope: disposable local QA database, deliberate contention and pool saturation; precomputed image provider with a fixed 5ms fixture delay; not production capacity
previous_isolated_saturation_evidence.limitation: Brief deliberate saturation validates stale-write rejection, not a bound on long-running pool waits or production throughput.

decision.reason: Observed production connection acquisition and current SQL samples do not show a resource bottleneck. Preserve current behavior and collect mixed-load/authorization/keepalive evidence before selecting queue and wait budgets.
decision.remaining_boundary: Ten application connections with queueLimit=0 and a 50s InnoDB lock wait limit can still leave requests pending during future saturation; frontend timeout alone does not bound server work.

browser.scope: isolated built application and disposable local database, real upload/authorization/query boundary with simulated OSS/SMS; no production writes
